priority.when: Always use first to find existing research and relevant data
priority.why: Semantic search finds research patterns and user data better than keywords

priority.when: After identifying relevant files with search_files
priority.why: Get full context of existing research, analytics, and user feedback

priority.when: When research requirements need clarification or stakeholder input
priority.why: Ensures research aligns with business needs and user requirements

priority.when: Creating research reports, plans, and documentation
priority.why: Creates comprehensive research deliverables and documentation

use_case.name: finding_existing_research
use_case.description: Locate previous research studies and reports

use_case.name: analyzing_user_feedback
use_case.description: Find user feedback and support tickets

best_practices.practice: Use broad search terms first, then refine with specific patterns
Search in multiple relevant directories for comprehensive coverage
Look for both current and historical research data
Include variations in terminology (e.g., customer vs user)

step.name: context_gathering
step.purpose: Understand existing research and product context

file_types.type: Research reports - Read executive summary first, then methodology
Analytics data - Focus on trends and patterns over time
User feedback - Look for recurring themes and pain points
Product specs - Identify user goals and success criteria

step.name: data_extraction
step.purpose: Extract relevant insights for current research

pattern.name: research_synthesis
pattern.approach: Read related files together to identify patterns and contradictions

pattern.name: trend_analysis
pattern.approach: Compare current data with historical research to spot trends

scenario.name: research_planning
scenario.question: What are the primary business objectives this research should support?

suggestions.suggest: Increase conversion rates by 15% in the next quarter
Reduce customer support tickets by 25% through improved UX
Validate new feature concepts before development investment
Understand why users are churning after the first week

scenario.name: participant_recruitment
scenario.question: Which user segments should we prioritize for this research?

suggestions.suggest: New users who signed up in the last 30 days
Power users who use the product daily
Users who recently canceled their subscriptions
Enterprise users with specific workflow needs

scenario.name: methodology_selection
scenario.question: What type of research approach would be most valuable?

suggestions.suggest: Qualitative interviews to understand user motivations
Usability testing to evaluate specific design solutions
Surveys to validate findings with larger sample
Analytics analysis to identify behavioral patterns

scenario.name: finding_validation
scenario.question: Which of these insights should we prioritize for action?

suggestions.suggest: High-impact, low-effort improvements for quick wins
Strategic insights that align with business goals

question_design_principles.principle: Provide specific, actionable options rather than open-ended suggestions
Include business impact and user benefit in suggestions
Offer different levels of research depth and investment
Consider resource constraints and timeline requirements

deliverable.name: interview_guide
deliverable.description: Structured guide for conducting user interviews

deliverable.name: persona_document
deliverable.description: Detailed user persona with research backing

deliverable.name: journey_map
deliverable.description: Visual mapping of user experience across touchpoints

standard.name: markdown_formatting
standard.description: Use consistent markdown for all research documents

guidelines.guideline: Use H1 for main title, H2 for sections, H3 for subsections
Use bullet points for lists, numbered lists for steps
Include tables for structured data where appropriate
Use code blocks for quotes and examples

standard.name: evidence_citation
standard.description: Always cite evidence for research claims

levels.level: High - Multiple data sources, large sample, clear patterns
Medium - Limited data, small sample, emerging patterns
Low - Single source, anecdotal, requires validation

use_case.name: finding_research_assets
use_case.description: Locate existing research materials and templates

primary_tools.tool: search_files - Find existing research and context
write_to_file - Create research plan and materials
read_file - Reference existing patterns and data
read_file - Review collected data and findings
write_to_file - Create analysis and synthesis documents
write_to_file - Create final reports and deliverables

check.verification: Review search results against expected file locations

check.name: context_understanding
check.question: Do I understand the full context from existing research?
check.verification: Summarize key findings and identify gaps

check.name: stakeholder_alignment
check.question: Are research objectives aligned with stakeholder needs?
check.verification: Review questions and suggestions for business relevance

check.name: documentation_quality

check.verification: Check against template requirements and standards
